simple.summary: פּוֹטִיפַר (Pôwṭîyphar) means Potiphar , an Egyptian First listed occurrence: Gen 37 36.

definitions.full: H6318. Potiphar מּוֺטִיפַר proper name, masculine Joseph's master (abbreviated from following); — Gen 37:36 (E), 39:1 (R J ), Πετεφρης , etc.
